NINE.ref_text: Most mornings I wake up before everyone else. The house is quiet. I make the coffee, I sit by the window, and I think about the day ahead.

COMM.design: Male English football radio commentator in his fifties from the north of England, gravelly slightly hoarse voice, strong northern English accent. Very excitable and fast, shouting on big moments, then deadpan and understated for the punchline.

lines.speaker: COMM
lines.text: Good morning, and welcome back to Bursa… sorry. His bedroom.
lines.tr: Günaydın, Bursa'ya tekrar hoş geldiniz… pardon. Yatak odasına.
lines.delivery: big warm match-intro energy, then a flat deadpan correction

lines.speaker: COMM
lines.text: One egg in. Four out. Defending: familiar.
lines.tr: Bir yumurta girdi. Dört çıktı. Savunma: tanıdık.
lines.delivery: match-report rhythm, driest on the last word

lines.speaker: COMM
lines.text: He ordered one espresso. Italy ordered four.
lines.tr: O bir espresso istedi. İtalya dört.

lines.speaker: COMM
lines.text: Trip: fourteen kilometres. Sat-nav suggests… Bologna.
lines.tr: Yol: on dört kilometre. Navigasyon öneriyor… Bologna.
lines.delivery: reading stats, small dramatic pause before Bologna

lines.speaker: COMM
lines.text: Fifty-four percent possession. Of the pavement. Still lost.
lines.tr: Yüzde elli dört topla oynama. Kaldırımda. Yine kaybetti.

lines.speaker: COMM
lines.text: Twenty-seven minutes. Three goals. He still feels it.
lines.tr: Yirmi yedi dakika. Üç gol. Hâlâ hissediyor.

lines.speaker: COMM
lines.text: He's going long! He's going… down the stairs.

lines.speaker: COMM
lines.delivery: low, serious, the music has changed
